title: Celestial Body Taxonomy
description: Taxonomy schema for classifying celestial bodies in the Solar System. Defines categories matching the frontend body types and ML model labels.

items.title: Celestial Body Entry
items.description: A single celestial body entry with its taxonomic classification and physical metadata.

category.description: Top-level classification matching the frontend BodyType and ML model labels.

sub_category.description: Sub-classification within the top-level category (e.g., 'Terrestrial', 'Gas Giant', 'Ice Giant', 'Kuiper Belt Object', 'Main Belt', 'NEA', 'Trojan', 'Rover', 'Orbiter', 'Telescope', 'Lander').

name.description: Official IAU name or mission name of the celestial body.

mass_kg.description: Mass of the celestial body in kilograms. Zero when unknown or not applicable.

orbital_period_days.description: Orbital period around the primary body in Earth days. Zero for the Sun, escaped spacecraft, or interstellar passers-through.

composition_type.description: Primary bulk composition type. 'silicate' for rocky bodies, 'ice' for icy bodies, 'gas' for gas-dominated bodies, 'plasma' for stars, 'metal' for metallic bodies.
